bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
src=d611f2d4edf8414c21ecd1d43336debfe48319b1
target="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/sticker-poll-$src"
test -f "$target/src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs" || exit 61
grep -Fqx 'WORKDIR /opt/videobot' "$target/deploy/Dockerfile" || exit 62
grep -Fqx 'COPY src ./src' "$target/deploy/Dockerfile" || exit 63
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Config.WorkingDir}}' create-videobot:poll-candidate)" = /opt/videobot || exit 64
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint /bin/sh create-videobot:poll-candidate -c '
test -d /opt/videobot || exit 80
test -d /opt/videobot/src || exit 81
test -d /opt/videobot/src/runtime || exit 82
test -f /opt/videobot/src/runtime/main.mjs || exit 83
test -f /opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs || exit 84
exit 0'
